selected_script.angle: Absurd astronaut grandfather rescues family from bedroom closet shoe clutter
selected_script.hook: Tired of stepping over messy shoe piles every time you open the closet door?

usage_steps_used: Hang the 4 metal hooks over the top edge of the door
Attach the top metal rings of the organizer onto the 4 metal hooks
Insert shoes or items into the 20 angled clear-side pockets

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-1.5s: Close-up of a messy pile of shoes blocking a bedroom door. 1.5-3s: A grandfather wearing a shiny space helmet enters holding the black UVIAHOMI organizer and says 'Let's organize this!' 3-6s: The 4 metal hooks are placed over the top edge of the door, and the top metal rings of the organizer are attached to them. 6-10s: Hands inserting sneakers into the 20 angled clear-side pockets.
video_001_part_01.audio: 0-1.5s: [Clatter of shoes] 1.5-3s: Grandfather: 'Let's organize this!' 3-6s: [Upbeat transition music] 6-10s: Clear sides make it easy to see everything.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: Fast-cut showing the organizer on a laundry room door storing folded towels. 4-8s: The closet door closing smoothly, with the neat 10-tier organizer holding pairs of shoes clearly visible through the clear PVC panels. 8-10s: Text display 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
video_001_part_02.audio: 0-4s: Fits standard doors and works for towels too. 4-8s: Hold up to 30 pairs easily. 8-10s: A simple upgrade for everyday use.
